From your first variable to calling an API, in five sections. Each section has a **lesson** to read, **exercises** to try on your own (with hints if you are stuck) and their **solutions**.

Each section has a zip with the lessons, the exercises and the data, so you can run everything on your computer (Python 3 with Jupyter, or [Anaconda](https://www.anaconda.com/download)). Solutions stay on this site.

1. **Python basics**: Types, operators, strings, data structures, conditions, loops and functions. [Lesson](01-python-basics/lessons/python-basics.ipynb) · [Exercises](01-python-basics/exercises/python-basics.ipynb) · [Solutions](01-python-basics/solutions/python-basics.ipynb)
2. **NumPy and pandas**: Arrays with NumPy, then loading, cleaning, combining and reshaping tables with pandas. [Lesson](02-numpy-pandas/lessons/numpy-pandas.ipynb) · [Exercises](02-numpy-pandas/exercises/numpy.ipynb) · [Solutions](02-numpy-pandas/solutions/numpy.ipynb)
3. **Data visualisation**: Exploring a dataset with Plotly Express: distributions, comparisons, relationships. [Lesson](03-data-visualization/lessons/data-visualization.ipynb) · [Exercises](03-data-visualization/exercises/ibm-employees.ipynb) · [Solutions](03-data-visualization/solutions/ibm-employees.ipynb)
4. **Interactive charts**: Subplots, sliders, dropdowns and animations with plotly.graph_objects. [Lesson](04-interactive-charts/lessons/interactive-charts.ipynb) · [Exercises](04-interactive-charts/exercises/earthquakes.ipynb) · [Solutions](04-interactive-charts/solutions/earthquakes.ipynb)
5. **Working with APIs**: What an API is, and how to call one from Python with requests. [Lesson](05-apis/lessons/apis.ipynb) · [Exercises](05-apis/exercises/bitcoin.ipynb) · [Solutions](05-apis/solutions/bitcoin.ipynb)
